title: Ordered exception before broad allow
description: Deny a restricted LAN host before the broader LAN HTTP allow; both policies use the same DMZ destination.
task_prompt: Move the restricted deny before the broad LAN HTTP allow so first-match order protects the exception.
help: Required order: policy ID 10 DENY-RESTRICTED-HTTP must appear before policy ID 20 ALLOW-LAN-HTTP.

cases.description: The restricted host must stop at the first, narrower deny.
A regular LAN host must continue to the broader allow.

flows.description: A host immediately outside the restricted object may use the broad allow.
The restricted host remains denied for a service outside HTTP.
